audit.why: 57.57% over 337 games — Talon-favoured across every phase; page rating EVEN 5.5/10 is conservative but the packet chart backs Talon on all rows, and diff ratings are the mirror-fix tool's domain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart is blanket 'Skill' while content win[] and packet levelChart read Talon on all seven rows.
audit.why: Content whys are kit-grounded (W Seismic Shove her only peel, R is a roam tool); full layer is the stale side.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[].side moved to Talon with matching whys; early ratings raised to 6/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Shadow Assassin' (fabricated — real name Shadow Assault) appears in spikes[1].text AND whys[4]. Riot's E text says mines stun enemies who DASH through — Talon's Q leap and E are dashes, an interaction the page never stated. 12 misgendered fields; cooldowns field had no digits; two pasted trade-string bullets.
audit.why: Kit numbers: W 14s rank 1, E 14s flat, Q 7s, R 180s rank 1. The dash-stun on Unraveled Earth is the matchup's hidden trap for a dash-reliant assassin.
audit.corrected: Names fixed both places, dash-through-mines warning added to cooldowns and phase whys, pronouns fixed, numbered cooldowns.

audit.why: Most punishable cooldown is Seismic Shove (14s rank 1, her only peel) — now numbered.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dash-stun on Unraveled Earth mines was missing everywhere.
audit.why: Riot's own E text: enemies who dash through or are knocked through are stunned — directly punishes Talon Q/E.
audit.corrected: Now stated in breakdown.cooldowns, phases[2].why, and dosFull[1].d.

notes: Q/W 'grounding' derived flags contradict Riot's own descriptions (Worked Ground affects Taliyah's casts, W is a knock — neither text says enemy dashes are disabled), so grounding was not asserted anywhere. The real anti-dash tool is E's dash-stun mines, straight from Riot's text, and it is now on the page. All 13 lint findings addressed.
